cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is ACA303, a flight from Wuhan to Vancouver, you are at stand 233 and information F received, request Wuhan Delivery for your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航303，从武汉飞往温哥华，你现在在233机位，收到了通播F，向武汉放行请求管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, ACA303, stand 233, information F, request ATC clearance to Vancouver.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，加航303，233机位，通播F，请求飞往温哥华的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to destination Vancouver, runway 04, ZF-01D departure, flight planned route, initial altitude 1,500m, cruising level 9,500m, request level change en route, squawk 3252, departure frequency 123.32.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，武汉放行，可以飞往目的地温哥华，跑道04，ZF-01D离场，计划航路，初始高度1500米，巡航高度9500米，入行后转高度，应答机3252，离场频率123.32。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to destination Vancouver, runway 04, ZF-01D departure, flight planned route, initial altitude 1,500m, cruising level 9,500m, request level change en route, squawk 3252, departure frequency 123.32, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以飞往目的地温哥华，跑道04，ZF-01D离场，计划航路，初始高度1500米，巡航高度9500米，入行后转高度，应答机3252，离场频率123.32，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [Call Wuhan Ground for your push back and start-up instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【呼叫武汉地面，请求推出开车指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA303, stand 233, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航303，233机位，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, Wuhan Ground, push back and start up approved, push to taxiway Z4, face east.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，武汉地面，可以推出开车，推到滑行道Z4，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, push to taxiway Z4, face east, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，推到滑行道Z4，面朝东，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [You have completed your engine start-up, you are ready for taxi, call Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在已经完成了开车，你准备好滑行了，呼号武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA303, start-up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航303，完成开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A, hold short of A6.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，经由滑行道Z4，A滑行到跑道04外等待点，在A6等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A, hold short of A6, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A滑行到跑道04外等待点，在A6等待，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [The airport is experiencing icing conditions. You need to perform de-icing procedures, call Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 机场遇到了积冰情况，你需要执行除冰程序，呼叫武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA303, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航303，请求除冰。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, roger, taxi to de-icing area 5 via A5.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，收到，经由A5滑行到5号除冰区。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to de-icing area 5 via A5, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由A5滑行到5号除冰区，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [You are now holding short of runway 04, you are fully ready for takeoff, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在跑道04外等待，你准备好起飞了，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA303, holding short of runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航303，在跑道04外等待，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, Wuhan Tower, behind the BAW747 on short final, line up behind, runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，武汉塔台，在短五边上的英航747后面，上跑道等待，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Behind the traffic/BAW 747 on short final, line up behind, runway 04, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在短五边上的英航747/航空器后面，上跑道等待，跑道04，加航303。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, after airborne, contact Departure 119.7. Surface wind 080 at 4 m/s, cleared for takeoff, runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，离地后，联系离场119.7。地面风080度，4米每秒，可以起飞，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 04, 119.7, ACA303.

cards.audioText: N: [You are passing 900m for 1,500m. Your No.3 engine vibration indication is near the maximum limit, call Wuhan Departure for a holding pattern at 1,200m to perform the checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在过900米上1500米，你的3号发动喘振指示接近最大值，呼叫武汉离场，在1200米加入等待程序，以此执行检查单。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA303, passing 900m for 1,500m. Our No.3 engine vibration indication is near the maximum limit, request a holding pattern at 1,200m to perform the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航303，过900米上1500米。我们的3号发动喘振指示接近最大值，请求在1200米加入等待程序，以此执行检查单。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, roger, proceed direct to HZ, climb to and maintain 1,200m, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，收到，直飞HZ，上到1200米保持，可以的时候报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Proceed direct to HZ, climb to and maintain 1,200m, wilco, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HZ，上到1200米保持，照办，加航303。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, join the published holding pattern at HZ, expect further clearance at time 0135.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，在HZ加入公布的等待程序，预计在1点35分得到进一步许可。
cards.referenceText: Join the published holding pattern at HZ, expect further clearance at time 0135, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在HZ加入公布的等待程序，预计在1点35分得到进一步许可，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [You suspect the engine vibration problem is caused by icing, request Wuhan Departure for a higher level to leave the icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你怀疑发动机喘振问题是由积冰导致，向武汉离场请求高高度，离开积冰区。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA303, we suspect the engine vibration problem is caused by icing, request further climb to leave the icing area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航303，我们怀疑发动机喘振问题是由积冰导致，请求进一步爬升，离开积冰区域。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA303, roger, what level would you prefer?
N: [Ask the controller if 4,500m is available.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航303，收到，你喜欢哪个高度？
【询问管制员，4500米是否可用。】
cards.referenceText: We prefer 4,500m/Request 4,500m, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们更喜欢4500米/请求4500米，加航303。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA303, climb to and maintain 4,500m, expedite passing 2,700m.
N: [Read back the instruction and advise the controller you are climbing on reduced thrust and will require some time before reaching that altitude.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航303，上到4500米保持，加速过2700米。
【复诵指令，告知管制员，你正在减推力爬升，在到达那个高度之前需要一些时间。】
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 4,500m, unable expedite due reduced thrust, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到4500米保持，由于减推力，无法加速爬升，加航303。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA303, are you declaring an emergency?
N: [Tell Wuhan Departure, you are not declaring an emergency at this time, you still have to perform engine checks once you leave the icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航303，你需要宣布紧急情况吗？
【告知武汉离场，现在你不需要宣布紧急情况，你离开积冰区域后，还需要执行发动机检查。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, we will perform engine checks once we leave the icing area, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，我们离开积冰区域后，还需要执行发动机检查，加航303。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, roger, turn right heading 070, climb to and maintain 4,500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，收到，右转航向070，上4500米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 070, climb to and maintain 4,500m, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向070，上4500米保持，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [You have almost reached 4,500m, your No.3 engine is operating normally, you decided to continue to your destination, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你马上到4500米，你的3号发动机运行正常，你打算继续飞往目的地，呼叫武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA303, approaching 4,500m, No.3 engine is operating normally, we will continue to our destination.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航303，接近4500米，3号发动机运行正常，我们将继续飞往目的地。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, roger, contact Zhengzhou Control on 127.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，收到，联系郑州区调127.5。
